# Bisu Ghalan — Complete Profile & Knowledge Base

> Bisu Ghalan is a computer science student and security researcher from Bhaktapur, Nepal who builds Telegram bots, command-line tools, and full-stack web apps.

- Canonical Entity: Bisu Ghalan

---

## About & Background

Bisu Ghalan is a computer science student at Lincoln International College in Kathmandu (affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia), studying Cyber Security & Network Technology (Hons).
He is a security researcher and software developer who focuses on defensive security, network infrastructure, Telegram bots, command-line utilities, and full-stack web applications.

---

## Projects

### BinaryInspector
Safe, local Rust CLI for inspecting ELF binaries, headers, and security mitigations without executing them.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/binary-inspector
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/BinaryInspector
- Technologies: Rust, CLI, Security

### Paila
Travel & community platform bridging tourists and local communities in Nepal, built with Next.js and Supabase.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/paila
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/Paila
- Live Deployment: https://paila-prototype.vercel.app
- Technologies: NextJS, TypeScript, TailwindCSS

### TG-GithubBot
GitHub webhook handler bot for Telegram, streaming and formatting push, release, and deployment alerts.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/tg-github-bot
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/TG-GithubBot
- Live Deployment: https://t.me/DearGitNotifyBot
- Technologies: Go, Telegram, MongoDB

### ninfo
Fast Linux system information CLI in Nim capturing a whole-system kernel and hardware snapshot as JSON.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/ninfo
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/ninfo
- Technologies: Nim, CLI, Linux

### TG-WordGame
Wordle-style word game bot for Telegram with solo/multiplayer rounds, daily challenges, and leaderboards.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/tg-word-game
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/TG-WordGame
- Technologies: TypeScript, Telegram, Game

### Melody
Telegram group calls streaming bot for YouTube, Spotify, and Apple Music built with Python and Pyrogram.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/melody
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/Melody
- Technologies: Python, Telegram, API

### heroku-buildpack-bun
Unofficial Heroku buildpack for Bun: installs official binaries, caches builds, and runs bun install.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/heroku-buildpack-bun
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/heroku-buildpack-bun
- Technologies: Shell, Bun, DevOps

### SnakeGame-CLI
Cross-platform classic Snake game running entirely in the terminal with zero external GUI dependencies.
- Page: https://bisu.com.np/projects/snake-game-cli
- Source Code: https://github.com/bisug/SnakeGame-CLI
- Technologies: C++, CLI, Game
